delay_semantics: Composite pre-service delay is start time minus the previous event's completion within the same sequential truck case. It aggregates movement, traffic/transfer, dispatching and queueing; it is not a pure queue measure.
bottleneck_definition: A bottleneck candidate is an activity or resource at which a large amount of held-out case time accumulates. Frequency-weighted totals are primary; mean and p90 values describe severity. Causal attribution requires an intervention or a richer physical model.
